data.name: Operation Serval
data.detailed_description:
PlayTest – Late Summer 2026

The first battles are approaching. Join the battlefield when playtesting launches in late Summer 2026 and help shape the future of the game from day one.


About the Game

Command powerful armored vehicles in intense team-based battles where skill, tactics, and teamwork decide the outcome.

Built from the ground up for players who love realistic ground warfare, this game delivers authentic armored combat without aircraft, naval forces, or unnecessary distractions. Every match focuses entirely on the clash between tanks, armored fighting vehicles, and the crews that operate them.

Engage in large-scale team battles across detailed battlefields inspired by real-world terrain. Use positioning, armor angling, reconnaissance, and precision gunnery to outmaneuver and destroy enemy forces. A well-placed shot can disable critical vehicle components, knock out crew members, or ignite ammunition, making every engagement tense and rewarding.

Progress through a growing roster of historically inspired armored vehicles, each featuring unique strengths, weaknesses, and battlefield roles. Whether you prefer heavily armored breakthrough tanks, fast reconnaissance vehicles, or versatile tank destroyers, every vehicle offers a distinct combat experience.

Features:

• Ground combat only — pure armored warfare without aircraft interference
• Realistic vehicle physics, armor modeling, and damage systems
• Team-focused battles where coordination matters
• Detailed vehicle interiors and component-based damage
• Tactical gameplay rewarding positioning, map knowledge, and precision
• Expanding roster of armored vehicles and battlefields
• Designed by armored warfare enthusiasts for armored warfare enthusiasts

Victory isn't earned through luck. It's earned through strategy, knowledge, and mastery of your vehicle.

The game is currently available for testing on our website.
